xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4337: The git shim refuses commits and pushes off the workspace's feature branch

plan.title: The git shim refuses commits and pushes off the workspace's feature branch
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: sync-sources/rules/worktree-discipline.md admits that nothing checks branch drift: a workspace or item worktree whose HEAD moves to main (or detaches) keeps accepting commits and pushes (#3505, PAN-2204). The per-agent git shim in src/lib/launcher-git-guard.ts already intercepts every agent git call and already scopes itself to the agent's worktree, so it is the cheapest deterministic place to refuse them.
narratives.Proposal: In default mode, route commit, push, merge and cherry-pick through a new branch check that runs after the existing guardRoot target check. The expected branch is derived at call time from `git -C <target> rev-parse --show-toplevel`: only a linked worktree (top-level .git is a file) named feature-<name> expects feature/<name>, and <that>/.swarm/<item> expects feature/<name>-<item>. Any other toplevel has no expectation and passes through. On a mismatch or a detached HEAD the shim prints one line naming the expected branch and telling the agent to stop and report via pan tell, then exits 1. Behavior tests run the generated shim against a fixture repo with a workspace, an item worktree, a nested non-item worktree and a git-init wrapper. The universal worktree-discipline rule and reference/workers.mdx are updated to point at the shim. Full brief: .pan/drafts/PAN-4337.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Refusing pushes whose refspec names the default branch (#4344 owns that).
- Commits made outside guardRoot, including an agent that cd's into the primary checkout.
- Polyrepo sub-repo worktrees <ws>/<repo> and per-repo branch_prefix: they have no expectation and must pass through.
- Checking pull, revert, am, commit-tree, update-ref, checkout or switch.
- Following --git-dir, GIT_DIR or --work-tree in default mode.
- A pan verify:branch command, git hooks in registered projects, or a CI branch gate.
- Changing read-only mode, the gh shim, or the buildGitGuardLines signature.
- Any new launcher parameter or environment variable carrying the expected branch.
- A bypass switch, or any mention of OVERDECK_PAN_GIT_OP in refusal output.
- Adding OVERDECK_PAN_GIT_OP=1 to pan's own git calls so they skip the check.

autoDecisions.summary: Derive the expected branch from the target's git toplevel path, not from an issue-id parameter.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue says the shim knows the issue id, but buildGitGuardLines(agentId, guardRoot, mode) receives none; the issue's own design says 'derived rather than stamped', and a stamped value would be wrong for in-harness subagents committing in an item worktree.

autoDecisions.summary: Match the toplevel basename feature-<name>, not a workspaces/ parent directory.
Only enforce when the toplevel is a linked worktree (its .git is a file).
autoDecisions.rationale: commitCompletePlanningWorkspaceGit git-inits polyrepo scaffolds at the workspace root (planning-promotion.ts:256-259); that wrapper is named feature-<name> but sits on the init default branch, so a basename-only rule would refuse every commit in it. The test also excludes every primary checkout.

autoDecisions.summary: Check exactly commit, push, merge and cherry-pick, as exact subcommand tokens.
autoDecisions.rationale: That is the issue's list; exact tokens leave merge-base, merge-tree and merge-file untouched.
Refusing pushes to the default branch is #4344; this issue checks only the current branch.

autoDecisions.summary: Anything without an expectation passes through unchanged.
autoDecisions.rationale: Covers review/test agents whose guardRoot is the primary checkout, Claude Code isolation worktrees under .claude/worktrees, polyrepo sub-repos with their own branch_prefix, and test fixture repos, none of which the issue asks to police.

autoDecisions.summary: pan's own git commits and pushes from an agent pane go through the check.
autoDecisions.rationale: Only rebase-helper.ts sets OVERDECK_PAN_GIT_OP=1; on the correct branch pan passes, and refusing pan done's push from a drifted worktree is the intended outcome.

autoDecisions.summary: Refusal text says to stop and report via pan tell, matching worktree-discipline.md.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue requires a message that says to stop and report, not how to bypass.

autoDecisions.summary: Three items: shim change, behavior tests, docs; only the tests depend on the shim.
autoDecisions.rationale: Each is independently reviewable; the docs describe behavior already fixed by the PRD and share no files with the code items.

items.title: Default-mode git shim refuses commit/push/merge/cherry-pick off the derived branch

expected_outputs: both existing git-guard test files pass with no failures

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-1 (.pan/drafts/PAN-4337.md) exactly. (1) Add a plain-POSIX-sh constant BRANCH_CHECK_SH next to READ_ONLY_SHIM_SH and a branchCheckShimLines() helper that escapes every $ as \$ (mirror readOnlyShimLines). The script: for commit|push|merge|cherry-pick, read T="$_OVERDECK_REAL_GIT" -C "$_overdeck_git_target" rev-parse --show-toplevel; only if T is non-empty and T/.git is a regular file, split on /.swarm/ (ws=${T%/.swarm/*}, item=${T##*/.swarm/}), expect feature/<basename(ws) minus 'feature-'> when basename(ws) matches feature-?*, append -<item> when item is non-empty, and drop the expectation when item contains '/'. With an expectation, compare to `branch --show-current`; on mismatch or empty output echo one line to stderr ("Overdeck refused git <cmd>: <T> must be on branch <expected>, but it is on branch <actual>|a detached HEAD. Stop and report this via pan tell; do not commit or push from this worktree.") and exit 1; otherwise exec real git. (2) In buildGitGuardLines' default-mode array, change the first case to 'rebase|stash|reset|commit|push|merge|cherry-pick) ;;' and insert ...branchCheckShimLines() immediately after the guardRoot target-dir case and before the rebase/stash/reset case. Use _overdeck_git_target, never $PWD. No backslashes or backticks inside BRANCH_CHECK_SH. Read-only mode and the gh shim stay untouched; the function signature stays unchanged. (3) Extend the module header with the PAN-4337 paragraph from the PRD, including that --git-dir, GIT_DIR and --work-tree are not followed.

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-2. Append describe('branch check (PAN-4337)') to src/lib/__tests__/launcher-git-guard-behavior.test.ts, reusing the outer home and fixtureRepo. Fixture: bare origin bc-origin.git; primary bc-primary (git init -b main, one commit, remote origin); workspace <primary>/workspaces/feature-pan-1 via `git worktree add -b feature/pan-1`; item <workspace>/.swarm/w1 on feature/pan-1-w1; nested <workspace>/.claude/worktrees/agent-x on worktree-agent-x; wrapper <home>/wrapper-ws/feature-pan-2 via git init -b master. Install shims bc-workspace (guardRoot workspace), bc-item (guardRoot item) and bc-wrapper (guardRoot wrapper) with buildGitGuardLines. Move branches with real git `checkout --quiet --ignore-other-worktrees <branch>` or `--detach`, and restore the original branch in a finally in every test that moves one. Run the shim with spawnSync and an env that sets OVERDECK_PAN_GIT_OP='' plus GIT_AUTHOR_*/GIT_COMMITTER_* identity. Cover the 15 cases in the PRD table. Assert only on exit status, stderr and real-git ref state; never read source files, no skipIf/.only, no timers.
